wire.remote_compute.alone: --remote-status, --remote-cancel and --remote-delete are commands of their own: run one on its own, without --remote or other run options.
wire.remote_compute.api_override: Remote compute is sending your Radient login and requests to {host} instead of the default Radient API, because LOP_REMOTE_COMPUTE_API_URL is set. Unset it unless you control that host.
wire.remote_compute.api_override_invalid: LOP_REMOTE_COMPUTE_API_URL must be an https:// URL, or http:// on 127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost, with no userinfo, query or fragment, no whitespace, control or non-ASCII characters and no percent-encoding; remote compute did not start.
wire.remote_compute.bad_repo: Because this run clones the repository from the far end, --repo must be an https:// or ssh:// URL, or a git@host:path address; a local path cannot be used.
wire.remote_compute.bad_sha: The --sha value must be a full 40-character commit SHA: a branch name or an abbreviated hash could resolve to a different commit than the one this run was submitted for.
wire.remote_compute.conflict: That idempotency key was already used with a different request body. Pass a new one with --idempotency-key.
wire.remote_compute.delete_confirm: Delete remote run {run_id} ({name})? This is permanent: its logs and results are deleted too. [y/N]
wire.remote_compute.delete_confirm_unnam: Delete remote run {run_id}? This is permanent: its logs and results are deleted too. [y/N]
wire.remote_compute.delete_declined: Nothing was deleted: remote run {run_id} is unchanged.
wire.remote_compute.delete_in_flight: Remote run {run_id} is still in flight, so it was not deleted: it can still run and spend. Cancel it first with: lop exec --remote-cancel {run_id}
wire.remote_compute.delete_needs_yes: Deleting remote run {run_id} is permanent, and there is no terminal here to confirm it on. Re-run with --yes to delete it.
wire.remote_compute.disabled: Remote compute is off. Turn it on with `lop config edit remote_compute.enabled true`, then run this again.
wire.remote_compute.finished_expired: Remote run {run_id} finished: expired, so it reached its deadline before it was done.
wire.remote_compute.finished_unknown: Remote run {run_id} is no longer running, but Radient reported no outcome this build can read.
wire.remote_compute.interrupted: Stopped watching run {run_id}; it is still running remotely. Cancel it with: lop exec --remote-cancel {run_id}
wire.remote_compute.invalid_request: Radient rejected the request as invalid. That is a bug in this client, not something to retype.
wire.remote_compute.key_empty: An empty --idempotency-key is refused rather than replaced with a fresh key: leave the flag out to mint one, or pass the key of the run you are retrying.
wire.remote_compute.key_not_printable: The idempotency key must be printable ASCII: letters, digits and punctuation only, with no accents, tabs or newlines.
wire.remote_compute.key_too_long: The idempotency key is longer than {max_bytes} bytes, which the server refuses: pass a key of at most {max_bytes} bytes.
wire.remote_compute.local_only: {flag} only makes sense for a local run, so it cannot be combined with --remote.
wire.remote_compute.needs_prompt: --remote needs a prompt: pass the task as the one positional argument.
wire.remote_compute.needs_repo: --remote needs --repo <url> and --sha <commit>: this run never uploads local files, so name the repository and commit to check out.
wire.remote_compute.network_mismatch: Radient answered with a run from another network, or without a network id, so it cannot be reported as a run of this network.
wire.remote_compute.no_capacity: Radient has no remote-compute capacity right now; try again later.
wire.remote_compute.no_credit: Radient has no compute credit for this account, so the run was not admitted.
wire.remote_compute.preview_not_enabled: Remote compute is not enabled for this Radient account yet (preview).
wire.remote_compute.refusal_conflict: Radient refused this request as a conflict with the current state of the run or the account. Read the run again, or use a different name, then retry.
wire.remote_compute.replayed: The idempotency key matched an earlier submission, so this is remote run {run_id} and no new run was created.
wire.remote_compute.repo_no_remote: That directory is not a git repository with an origin remote, so there is no repository for the container to clone.
wire.remote_compute.repo_not_https_remot: The origin remote is not a credential-free https:// URL, and the container has no key or agent to clone over SSH. Point origin at an https:// URL first.
wire.remote_compute.repo_unpushed_commit: Commit {detail} is not on any origin branch. The container clones from the remote, so push this commit first.
wire.remote_compute.retrying: Radient reported an error for this run and retries it, so this watch continues.
wire.remote_compute.run_busy: That run or workload is already busy with another operation. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
wire.remote_compute.run_identity_mismatc: Radient answered for remote run {answered}, not the run {asked_for} that was asked for, so this response cannot be reported as that run's state.
wire.remote_compute.run_limit: This account is at its limit for cloud runs. Wait for running runs to finish and settle (a finished run frees its slot once it is settled), or cancel one (lop exec --remote-cancel <run id>), then try again.
wire.remote_compute.run_limit_legacy: This server still counts finished runs toward the limit until they are deleted, so deleting is the only way to free a slot here. Deleting one is permanent: its logs and results go with it. Each run below can be deleted with lop exec --remote-delete <run id>, which asks for confirmation first.
wire.remote_compute.slot_heading: Finished runs that can be deleted:
wire.remote_compute.status_network_match: network checked: this run is in {network_id}, this device's network.
wire.remote_compute.status_network_misma: network checked: this run is in {network_id}, which is not this device's network.
wire.remote_compute.status_network_uncon: network unconfirmed: this device cannot tell which network this run belongs to.
wire.remote_compute.status_unknown: status: {status} (not a status this build knows; still watching)
wire.remote_compute.still_running: Run {run_id} is still running past the {max_hours}-hour limit Radient reported for it, so this command stopped watching. Check it with: lop exec --remote-status {run_id}
wire.remote_compute.submitted:
Remote run {run_id} submitted.
network (confirmed by Radient): {network_id}
wire.remote_compute.unknown_run: Radient has no such remote run for the selected login.
wire.remote_compute.unreachable: Radient could not be reached; check the network and try again.
wire.remote_compute.unreadable_envelope: Radient's response format has changed, and this lop build cannot read it. Update lop with `lop-update` and try again.
wire.remote_compute.yes_only_with_delete: --yes only applies with --remote-delete: it confirms a delete this command would otherwise ask about on the terminal.
